contract.decode_touch_mapping: the current node must be resident in the frozen baseline state; after all Candidate unit events at that decode step, both (GDN,current)/(ATT,current) units must be decode-ready. Intra-pair intermediate states are not independent node events
contract.logical_state: each event completion at step t uses the frozen simulate_v3 five_tuple at the same decode step
contract.policy_difference_boundary: non-current unit residency may differ from node-level frozen residency; this is the allowed granularity-policy difference, not an L1 violation
contract.state_model: Candidate A has one unit state bit, res: resident/non-resident; it does not maintain a separate externalized state bit
contract.terminology_boundary: externalized is baseline historical vocabulary: a once-resident unit later capacity-evicted; cold-load is first acquisition of a never-resident unit; the runner rehydrate event is the umbrella for both acquisitions
contract.transition_shape: rehydrate requires prior non-resident -> now resident; externalize requires prior resident -> now non-resident

execution_state.method: sys.settrace direct runtime capture of frozen simulate_v3 locals after capacity enforcement

input.capacity_model: equal unit slots; KiB disclosed, not weighted

L1.fault: externalize event marked was_resident=False; logical five_tuple unchanged
L1.propagation: if detection fails, FINAL fails; the synthetic fault itself is not counted as an experiment violation
